tasks.title: Add X-API-Version header to respond()
tasks.intent: Change lib/respond.mjs so respond(body) returns { status: 200, body, headers: { "X-API-Version": "1" } }, leaving the status and body values untouched.

tasks.title: Update respond test for the header field
tasks.intent: Update tests/respond.test.mjs: the existing deepEqual asserts the exact two-field shape, which the intentionally-added headers field changes, so the expectation becomes the three-field shape including headers: { "X-API-Version": "1" }. Add explicit assertions that status stays 200 and body passes through, pinning the preserved halves. Without this task the API-001-A suite run cannot be green.

tasks.title: Run suite for API-001-A acceptance
tasks.intent: Run node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" and require exit code 0, executing the updated tests that pin the header's presence and the preserved status/body fields.

observations.statement: tests/respond.test.mjs deep-equals the exact response shape, so the added headers field necessarily invalidates the old expectation; updating it is part of the specified change, while status and body remain pinned by new explicit assertions.
